why: Issue #531 itself, restored: the level switch stops being an announced fact and goes back to being inferred from `roundStartTick`, which cannot see it. `createWorld` stamps every world it builds with `roundStartTick: 1` and only `resetArena` ever moves it, so a level cleared on the FIRST attempt hands `sync` an incoming world whose 1 matches the outgoing world's 1, the guard stays silent, the tank's anchor survives at the previous board's coordinates, and the emit loop walks the gap in EMIT_SPACING steps printing the whole way. Measured on this module with the announcement ignored: two decals from a short drive became 158 in a straight line to the new spawn. Every pre-existing test in this file stayed green under exactly this mutation -- the round-boundary case drives the same switch with the two numbers UNEQUAL, so only a switch between two first-round worlds discriminates.
killedBy: tread trails: round boundary and level switch clears on an announced level switch whose two worlds share roundStartTick (#531)
